[[Greater demon]]s can be assigned by [[Krystilia]], [[Chaeldar]], [[Konar quo Maten|Konar]], [[Nieve]]/[[Steve]], and [[Duradel]]/[[Kuradal]]. Despite their "greater" status, they possess a somewhat lackluster drop table, with their two most valuable drops being the [[rune full helm]] and the [[hard clue scroll]]. There are many different types of greater demons residing around Gielinor; however, with the exception of the [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]], all have the same drop table. 

When not killing greater demons as part of Konar or Krystilia's tasks, players have many spots to choose from. The most common spots are the [[Chasm of Fire]] and [[Catacombs of Kourend]]. The Chasm of Fire is a cannonable area in a small space, allowing for plenty of AFK and fast kill times, along with [[Chasm_of_Fire#Contracts|contracts]] for challenging a stronger version of [[Yama]]. Catering to the increased drop rates will require more banking and less AFK time, however. The Catacombs of Kourend has access to the [[ancient shard]] and [[dark totem]] piece drops. It is also a [[Multicombat area]], allowing for players to AFK until the aggression timer expires, which can be easily reset.

In the [[Wilderness]], players have several spots to kill greater demons from. The most common would be the [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]] due to the enhanced drops, multiway area and allowing a cannon, but this spot is frequented often by player killers, so players should not bring items they are not willing to lose. The [[Demonic Ruins]] is a much worse spot, due to being a far deeper multiway area and players tend to teleport in via [[Annakarl Teleport]]s. A more secluded spot is the [[Lava Maze Dungeon]], but accessing it requires a long trek around the maze, or 82 [[Agility]] (boostable at 77) for a shortcut that cuts a significant amount of time.

Players who have completed [[While Guthix Sleeps]] may also kill [[Tormented Demon]]s for the progression of a greater demon task. These are a significant step up compared to normal greater demons and require a minimum of two combat styles in order to be fought. They provide extremely good experience rates (with each kill being 1,065 slayer experience) and can drop the valuable [[tormented synapse]], which is used to create high tier, best-in-slot demonbane weaponry, which makes them worth it for ironmen that frequently kill demonic creatures. See [[Tormented Demon/Strategies|their strategy page]] on more information on how to fight them.

The bosses [[Skotizo]] (''[[Skotizo/Strategies|guide]]'') and [[K'ril Tsutsaroth]] (''[[K'ril Tsutsaroth/Strategies|guide]]'') also count towards greater demons for the purpose of a slayer task. Skotizo requires a [[dark totem]] in order to access. He drops clue scrolls, making it a great option for players that want to complete some Treasure Trails. K'ril requires a minimum of level 70 [[Hitpoints]] and partial completion of [[Troll Stronghold]] in order to access. His bodyguard [[Tstanon Karlak]] also counts as a greater demon.

==Safespots==
[[File:Brimhaven dungeon greater demon safe spot.png|thumb|right|One safespot in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]]]]
There are a number of [[safespots]] which players using [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] may use:

* [[Brimhaven Dungeon]]: Standing at the end of a vine just north-west of the stairs, the fungus west of the stairs, in the upper level at the end of the path, and at the farthest south-east corner of the plateau.
* [[Catacombs of Kourend]]: under the arch which divides the Greater Demon area, and at the extreme north-east corner of the dungeon behind the rope exit.
* [[Chasm of Fire]]: behind the many pillars and narrow pathways.
* [[Entrana Dungeon]]: behind the burnt corpses (use the second square south of the stalagmite and two squares away from the sitting burnt corpse).
* [[Karuulm Slayer Dungeon]]: at the entrance of the Greater Demon chamber.
* [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]]: stalagmites at the entrance of the Greater Demon chamber, halberds may also be used.
* [[Isle of Souls Dungeon]]: behind the two rocks on the Eastern side of the inner wall, south of the skeleton and demonic symbols.
* [[Ogre Enclave]]: in the south east corner of the dungeon are 4 greater demons trapped behind a fence. (requires [[Watchtower]] quest to be completed until the point where you can access the enclave)

==Trivia==
* During the [[A Kingdom Divided]] quest, the [[Judge of Yama (A Kingdom Divided)|Judge of Yama]] is considered a greater demon for the purpose of a Slayer task.
